description: 한국가스공사_한국의 월별 천연가스 수입현황 및 비용 아시아 [gas networks] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 한국가스공사. 한국무역협회(KITA) 통계를 기반으로 산출한 한국의 아시아 대륙산 LNG 월별 수입현황 및 비용에 관한 자료입니다. 아시아(말레이시아, 인도네시아, 브루나이 등)는 지리적 인접성으로 운송비 절감이 가능한 전통적 LNG 수입처입니다. 본 데이터는 대륙별 LNG 수입 동향 분석 및 조달 전략 수립을 위해... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 한국가스공사. Its tags are LNG 수입물량, LNG 수입가격, 아시아, 수입량, 단위가격. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
